tonight.headline: Tuten is out — start Jonathan Taylor
body: Bad news first. Jacksonville ruled Bhayshul Tuten out for Sunday (jaguars.com; NBC 27 Nov 20:56Z). He is still in your RB slot, and ESPN still shows his 18.7 — not real. Boswell has 7 with Pittsburgh-Denver under way; you trail JuiceJam 33.6 to 65.6, and ESPN gives you 17%.

One move, before 12:00 Sunday: Jonathan Taylor from the bench into Tuten's RB slot. Isaiah Likely carries no designation on the Giants' final report (Yahoo 27 Nov 21:04Z), so the Pitts fallback is retired.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: JuiceJam have Gibbs' 48.2 banked and Stroud (20.5), Collins (15.3), Pollard (14.3) and McConkey (12.3) to come. Leaving Tuten in place turns Taylor's 14.0 into a zero.

case.label: Their soft spot
case.body: Tony Pollard did not practise Thursday — listed as rest, not injury (Titans' official report, carried from this morning); McConkey's quarterback, Herbert, is questionable in protocol (CBS 27 Nov). A watch, not a hole.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Daniels against Arizona, who allow the most QB points. With the swap made ESPN reads roughly 112 to 145.

case.body: Anthony Richardson, named the starter after Daniel Jones was released (CBS 25 Nov; giants.com). The Giants allow little on the ground by the Tuesday grades, but Indianapolis' own defence ranks 28th in points allowed (giants.com 27 Nov).

worthALook.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
worthALook.lead: Tuten's replacement and a free agent — but a committee back who would not start for you.

case.label: The player
case.body: Inherits Tuten's 87% of the backfield on the screen; NBC (27 Nov 20:56Z) says he 'should be added wherever he is available'. Probable with the hand (Footballguys).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: Coen named the whole room — Rodriguez, Ameer Abdullah, LeQuint Allen Jr. — not one back (jaguars.com 27 Nov). ESPN's 6.6 predates the ruling, but even repriced he would need to clear Taylor's and Gordon's 14.0 to start, and a free agent added to sit costs a bench spot for one week.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: ESPN reprices him above 14.0 before 10:30 Sunday — then add him as a free agent (no priority) and drop Aaron Jones Sr.
